content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments represent a decentralized method for selling digital products directly to consumers without intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal. This architecture allows creators to take full control of their online sales, ensuring that they retain the maximum revenue from each transaction. Unlike traditional platforms, which often charge steep fees—Gumroad, for example, takes 10% on every sale—NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This difference is substantial, especially for creators selling products at scale, where every dollar counts.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the Solana payment architecture leverages blockchain technology to facilitate transactions directly between buyers and sellers. Smart contracts handle payment verification, ensuring that once a transaction is confirmed, the digital product is delivered automatically. This system minimizes reliance on centralized platforms, allowing for immediate access to funds and products. The use of NOWPayments for processing ensures that transactions are swift and secure, with low fees and no need for buyer accounts, making it an ideal solution for digital creators.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where mainstream payment processors are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, or digital templates, this system empowers you to bypass traditional barriers and reclaim your revenue. By utilizing Solana payments, you can connect with a global audience while enjoying the benefits of low transaction fees and fast payment processing. This framework is essential for anyone looking to establish a sustainable online business without platform restrictions.
NOWPayments offers the lowest fees in the industry at just 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Solana payment architecture is composed of several key components: a reliable hosting service like Cloudflare Pages, backend logic managed through Cloudflare Workers, and a database for order management such as Supabase. Additionally, the integration of NOWPayments facilitates the actual payment processing, allowing for automatic cryptocurrency verification. Each of these components works seamlessly together, creating a robust infrastructure that supports the sale and delivery of digital products without the need for third-party intervention.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To begin deploying your Solana payment architecture, start by setting up a hosting account with Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure your backend using Cloudflare Workers to handle the transaction logic. Ensure your product storage is managed through Supabase, and integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. Finally, test the entire system end-to-end to confirm that purchases flow smoothly from payment to product delivery. This process can be expedited using the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe is entirely possible using a decentralized payment architecture like Solana. By leveraging platforms like NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, you can facilitate sales directly to consumers while avoiding high fees charged by traditional services. This not only enhances your profit margins but also gives you full control over your business.
Gain complete control over your transactions with a decentralized payment architecture.

If you're looking for a way to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This comprehensive package includes all the blueprints and templates you need to create a sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
